spans.s:
--a Mt. on the East of Meru;
1: भा. V. १६. २७; वा. ३५. 8; ४२. २०.
connects नील and नैषध hills.
2: Vi.

--the fire originating in waters; this exists in the men's bellies and cannot be put out by waters; burns without fuel; it has no ज्वाल or glow.
1: Br. II. २४. १२; वा. ५३. 8, १०.
Father of विद्वान्- agni.
2: Br. II. १२. ३४.
